verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Justworks handles W-4/withholding collection and payroll processing (justworks-docs-7, -9, -1), which is consistent with automated tax handling, but no direct documentation explicitly describes automatic calculation, filing, and remittance of federal/state/local payroll taxes across jurisdictions. This is a well-known PEO capability but the pack lacks explicit confirming detail, so it's only weakly substantiated.
